comment: Align platform broker telemetry signals to the signal matrix: stop emitting isPlatformBrokerRequest in interactive flows (acquireTokenPopup, ssoSilent, handleRedirectPromise) so it is set only for the direct-broker silent flow, and set isNativeBroker plus brokerErrorName/brokerErrorCode on terminal (no-fallback) native broker errors while leaving isNativeBroker unset when the error falls back to a web flow [#8699](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8699)
